name: Rappid Valves (India) Ltd
tagline: Small NSE-SME-listed valve manufacturer with real, dated Navy/BHEL defence orders and a genuine shipyard-qualification moat - but this pass corrects the original 'ROCE ~48%' and '~Rs 27 Cr trailing sales' claims (actual FY26 revenue Rs 53.23 Cr, ROCE collapsed to ~16.2% from 38% in FY23) and surfaces a serious cash-conversion crisis (deeply negative operating cash flow despite reported profit, debtor days nearly tripling, IPO proceeds reallocated to plug a working-capital shortfall).
business_overview: Rappid Valves (India) Ltd manufactures and exports industrial valves for hydrocarbon/oil & gas, upstream/downstream/midstream, chemical, power, marine, mining and general-industry applications, with shipyard-approval credentials positioning it as a tier-2 supplier into Indian Navy shipbuilding programmes via BHEL (e.g. the Fleet Support Ship/FSS programme). Listed on NSE SME (IPO Sep 2024, price band Rs 210-222, subscribed 117x). Promoter Mr. Gaurav Vijay Dalal (22 years industry experience). Seeded 2026-09-13 via untrusted X triage (@rishithegreat41).

Rs 36.51 Cr -> Rs 52.13 Cr (+42.8%) -> Rs 53.23 Cr (+2.1%) - growth stalled in FY26, NOT the ~Rs 27 Cr trailing base originally cited

fundamentals_narrative: This deep-dive pass materially corrects the original light-triage write-up on two central bull-case numbers: (1) ROCE is not ~48% - it has actually fallen from 38.08% (FY23) to 24.31% (FY24) to ~16.2% currently, a real and significant decline in capital efficiency, not an 'elite, sustained' return profile; (2) trailing revenue is not ~Rs 27 Cr - FY26 actual revenue was Rs 53.23 Cr (essentially flat YoY, +2.1%, after a strong +42.8% FY25), meaning the company is roughly 2x the size the original write-up assumed and its FY26 growth actually stalled rather than compounding toward the guided ~50%. More seriously, this pass surfaces a genuine cash-conversion crisis: operating cash flow was deeply negative (-Rs 12.82 Cr in FY25) against a positive operating profit of Rs 9.93 Cr - profit is accumulating in receivables, not converting to cash. Debtor days worsened from 83 (FY24) to 135-170, and working-capital days stretched from ~59 to 233-234 over two years. In March 2026, shareholders approved reallocating Rs 7.64 Cr of IPO proceeds toward working capital - a concrete confirmation that the original capital plan was insufficient and receivables pressure (likely linked to slower government/PSU payment cycles via BHEL/Navy contracts) had outpaced it. Set against this, the moat and near-term order-flow story is genuinely real: Rappid won an Rs 18.05 Cr BHEL naval-defence order (Indian Navy FSS programme, ~34% of FY26 turnover, execution staggered through FY27-28) and further Rs 29.85 Cr of FSS-programme orders in Q1 FY27, taking the executable order book to ~Rs 40 Cr (+~60% YoY) and driving a +28% YoY Q1 FY27 revenue print - the first genuine reacceleration signal, but only one quarter old and set against an otherwise deteriorating cash and returns picture.

verdict_headline: Real shipyard-qualified valve maker with genuine, dated Navy/BHEL order wins and a corrected (larger, cheaper-on-sales) revenue base - but this pass found the original 'ROCE ~48%' claim does not hold up (actual ROCE has collapsed to ~16.2% from 38% in FY23) and surfaced a serious cash-conversion crisis (negative operating cash flow, ballooning working-capital days, an emergency IPO-proceeds reallocation). HIGH CAUTION set; conviction downgraded to Low-Medium; thesis 'neither' pending clean cash-flow evidence.
verdict_reasoning: Deep-dive pass 1 corrects two central bull-case numbers from the original light-triage pass: ROCE is ~16.2% (declining from 38.08% FY23), not ~48%; trailing revenue is Rs 53.23 Cr (FY26), not ~Rs 27 Cr - the growth-off-a-tiny-base framing was based on an understated revenue figure.

More materially, this pass found a genuine cash-conversion crisis (FY25 operating cash flow -Rs 12.82 Cr against +Rs 9.93 Cr operating profit; debtor days 83->135-170; working-capital days ~59->233-234) that the original pass, sourced only from a single forum concall mention, did not surface. Shareholders approving a Rs 7.64 Cr IPO-proceeds reallocation to working capital in March 2026 is concrete confirmation of real financial strain, not a forum caution on paper.

HIGH CAUTION set: while this doesn't match the two textbook triggers (promoter-holding collapse, auditor resignation) literally, a documented negative-OCF/positive-PAT divergence this severe, alongside debt roughly doubling and an emergency capital reallocation, is a quality-of-earnings/liquidity-stress signal of comparable severity that the red-flag framework exists to catch - conviction capped Low-Medium pending clearer cash-flow evidence.

deep_dive.conviction_update: Medium-High -> Low-Medium. The original call rested on two headline numbers (ROCE ~48%, trailing sales ~Rs 27 Cr) sourced from a single forum concall mention - neither survives primary-document verification. More importantly, this pass found a genuine, documented cash-conversion crisis (negative operating cash flow against positive operating profit, ballooning working-capital days, an emergency capital reallocation) that the original light-triage pass did not check for.
